propositions: Plan-review operations returning non-degraded PASS verdict do not persist a signed plan-review attestation by default on all public routes, discarding the durable gate artifact needed by the claim path.
Library review_plan and CLI review-plan routes lack a unified default-signing finalization seam, leaving the signing contract undefended against refactors that could silently flip the default.
MCP review_plan tool exposes no caller-facing sign parameter and derives signing only from server read-only mode, preventing explicit unsigned requests at that boundary.
Explicit opt-out of attestation signing requires consistent syntax across boundaries (--no-sign for CLI, sign=False for library) with clear output and recovery path documentation.
Re-invoking plan-review with a current claim-valid attestation must idempotently reuse it without re-running the LLM or emitting duplicate signature events.
